_comment: Cards for tests/unit/copies/test_copy_triggering_ability.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_cta_copier` is Ashnod the Uncaring's trigger without the deathtouch body: a noncreature artifact, so no creature-sacrifice cost can take it. `t_cta_striker` is a sacrifice ability with a target, so the copy's new targets are visible on a life total. The other abilities are shared: t_gisa_outlet (sacrifice, the sacrificed creature bound for the effect) and t_mutator (no sacrifice).

cards.name: Test Activation Copier
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, you may copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

abilities.text: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, you may copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Test Sacrifice Striker
cards.oracle_text: Sacrifice a creature: Target player loses 2 life.

abilities.text: Sacrifice a creature: Target player loses 2 life.
